input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is PAINTING STYLE ONLY, never copy its person, framing or pose. Keep the same face, headwear, clothes and single set of equipment. For ALL poses the camera sees BACK surfaces. During collapse fall FORWARD AWAY from the camera, finally FACE-DOWN with the back uppermost and the face HIDDEN. Never turn to face the viewer, never roll onto the back. Older powerful man, deep brown skin and thick short greying beard, broad pale ochre hooded shoulder wrap over ivory layered cloth, stone charms and leather pouches, heavy gnarled staff with angular stone head. Floating stone motes and compact dust. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly THREE columns by TWO rows, SIX complete sequential poses of this same figure collapsing. Row 1: 1 upright ready; 2 knees/legs buckle, torso drops; 3 body low and leaning to the ground. Row 2: 4 torso falls forward or sideways, nearly horizontal; 5 entire torso and head touch ground; 6 completely still fully LYING ON GROUND with equipment resting beside the body. Last pose must be fully lying, never sitting, crouching or kneeling. A harmless theatrical fall/rest, intact body, no blood, gore, wounds or injury detail. Each complete pose occupies ONLY HALF its spacious cell. Entire feet, staff and all equipment stay far from the image boundary. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only. Reference-3.png supplies the final LYING BODY posture only: torso and head resting completely against ground. Keep reference-1 identity and requested rear view. Lay the staff down too. Use this fully grounded endpoint to guide the last two keys, no hovering or propping torso up. CORRECTION: Final pose must lie fully flat, head touching ground, back uppermost, staff flat beside it. Use reference-3 endpoint. Keep all six complete poses and staff centered with very wide magenta gutters, no cropping.

arguments.Prompt:
Stylized game character animation sheet on a uniform solid vivid magenta #FF00FF background. Exactly 3 columns by 2 rows containing 6 sequential collapse poses of the exact character from reference-1.png, painted in the digital dark fantasy painterly style of reference-2.png.

Character details from reference-1.png: Powerful older man, deep brown skin, short greying beard, pale ochre hooded shoulder wrap worn over layered ivory cloth robes, leather pouches, stone charms, carrying a heavy gnarled staff with an angular stone head, with small floating stone motes and dust pebbles. Consistent character design, clothes, and equipment across all 6 poses.

View and perspective: Elevated 55-degree orthographic angle, rear-right three-quarter view (head and torso angled diagonally away from camera towards upper right, camera sees back surfaces throughout all poses). The character collapses forward away from the camera, ending face-down with back uppermost and face completely hidden from view. Never turns towards camera, never rolls onto back.

The 6 sequential collapse poses (3 columns, 2 rows):
Row 1:
1. Upright ready stance, viewed from rear-right with back facing camera, holding staff.
2. Knees and legs buckle, torso dropping lower while leaning forward away from camera.
3. Torso leaning low toward the ground, knees dropping further.
Row 2:
4. Torso falling forward away from camera, nearly horizontal above ground.
5. Torso and head touching ground, falling face-down with back uppermost.
6. Completely still, lying fully flat on the ground face-down with back uppermost, head resting on ground, face hidden, gnarled staff resting flat on the ground beside the body (referencing reference-3.png for the flat ground-resting posture). No propping up, completely flat lying defeat/rest posture.

Composition and layout:
- Aspect ratio 1:1 square animation sprite sheet.
- Exactly 3 columns by 2 rows with wide empty magenta gutters separating each cell.
- Each pose is isolated and centered within the middle 60% of its spacious cell, far from boundaries, identical anatomical scale.
- Pure solid magenta background #FF00FF across the entire sheet.
- No text, labels, numbers, borders, panel frames, grid lines, scene backgrounds, floor planes, or blood/gore.
- Stylized sculpted painterly volume, confident brushwork, cool upper-left directional lighting, smooth opaque cloth and worn metal highlights.
